label: NECESSARY_16: tautology, true under every truth-value assignment
definition: Tautology phi is BoxFree phi and, for every assignment s : A -> Prop of truth values to the atoms, TFHolds s phi. BoxFree admits atoms, falsum and implication (hence negation and conjunction) of the existing Modal.Formula language and excludes box and diamond. TFHolds is classical two-valued truth-functional evaluation. In ordinary words: a proposition of a truth-functional language that comes out true whatever the truth values of its elementary propositions, so that its truth needs no fact about which elementary propositions are true. Examples: p -> p, falsum -> p. Non-examples: an atom p (false under the assignment making p false); the K axiom (it contains box, so it is not in the fragment although it is K-valid); box p.
note: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred; Tractatus 4.46-4.4661 and 6.1-6.13 (tautology, truth for all truth-possibilities) are navigation only, and no source claim is made. Relation to the existing senses (all verified in the Tractarian logical-space batch, TruthCore.Causality.TractarianLogicalSpace, result controls and tautologyToAllFrameK): NECESSARY_16 strictly strengthens NECESSARY_14 (AllFrameKValidity), hence NECESSARY_13 and NECESSARY_15 through the existing strength order; strictness by the K axiom instance with q := p, which is a substitution instance of a propositional tautology: strictness comes only from the restriction to the truth-functional fragment, and every K-valid formula containing box is an equal witness. On the truth-functional fragment NECESSARY_14 gives NECESSARY_16, and NECESSARY_13 on any inhabited frame gives it too, so the three coincide there. NECESSARY_16 is a bounded instance of generic NECESSARY_5 (denial contradictory) for one fixed logic: tautology gives that no assignment satisfies the denial, and, with excluded middle as an explicit antecedent, the converse holds; likewise for the frame-relative DenialContradictory of LogicalNecessityContrast on an inhabited frame. It does not bind NECESSARY_5, which stays a family over logics, languages and interpretation domains. It is said of formulas, not of beings: 'n necessarily exists' is not a formula of the fragment (it needs box), so it is not a tautology in this sense. It is not NECESSARY_2 box-existence, NECESSARY_3 cannot-not-be or NECESSARY_4 per se necessity. First-order or quantified logical truth is a different profile and is not covered. NECESSARY_16 deliberately excludes tautologous substitution instances with modal subformulas, such as box p -> box p (true under every assignment to its maximal box subformulas); that wider notion would be a distinct intermediate sense between NECESSARY_16 and NECESSARY_14, not recorded here.
